name: com.saivs.sgsr2-optimized
description: Snapdragon Game Super Resolution 2 for Unity URP, optimized for low-tier mobile GPUs. No TAA dependency: the feature applies its own camera jitter and reconstructs motion from depth. Ships a kernel ladder (reference compute port, fused fragment, Lite, Ultra) with runtime toggles for on-device A/B comparison.

samples.description: Runtime panel with kernel toggles and GPU timings for on-device A/B.
